info.title: WuKongIM Trusted Product Management Beta Subset
info.description: A deliberately non-exhaustive Product HTTP contract for reviewed Channel management and canonical Conversation synchronization. Every operation is for a trusted backend or operator boundary. The default server composition does not authenticate these routes.

servers.description: Default Product HTTP listener for a local single-node cluster

tags.name: Channels
tags.description: Reviewed Channel metadata, durable subscriber, temporary subscriber, denylist, and allowlist mutations.

zh.description: 经过校准的 Channel 元数据、持久订阅者、临时订阅者、黑名单与白名单变更入口。

tags.name: Conversations
tags.description: Canonical bounded Conversation-list synchronization, retries, badge floors, hiding, and explicit activation.

zh.description: Canonical 有界会话列表同步、重试、红点下界、隐藏与显式激活入口。

post.description: Creates or updates one Channel. Integer flags are true only when exactly 1. With reset=1 the durable subscriber snapshot is replaced; a person Channel cannot carry subscribers. Disband is terminal in the current runtime and is not cleared by a later upsert.

zh.summary: 创建或更新 Channel 元数据
zh.description: 创建或更新一个 Channel。整数标志仅在值恰好为 1 时为 true。reset=1 会替换持久订阅者快照；个人 Channel 不能携带 subscribers。当前运行时中的 disband 是终态，后续 upsert 不会清除它。

x-codeSamples.label: Trusted backend (cURL)
x-codeSamples.source:
# Run only from the trusted backend or operator boundary.
curl --fail-with-body \
  --request POST \
  --url http://127.0.0.1:5001/channel \
  --header 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{"channel_id":"team-42","channel_type":2,"reset":1,"subscribers":["alice","bob"]}'

zh.label: 受信后端（cURL）
zh.source:
# 只在受信后端或运维边界运行。
curl --fail-with-body \
  --request POST \
  --url http://127.0.0.1:5001/channel \
  --header 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{"channel_id":"team-42","channel_type":2,"reset":1,"subscribers":["alice","bob"]}'

post.summary: Add or replace durable Channel subscribers
post.description: Adds durable subscribers, creating empty Channel metadata if needed. Omitting channel_type (or sending 0) selects group type 2 for compatibility. reset=1 replaces the subscriber snapshot. Person Channels and temp_subscriber=1 are rejected; use /tmpchannel/subscriber_set for temporary membership.

zh.summary: 添加或替换 Channel 持久订阅者
zh.description: 添加持久订阅者；必要时会先创建空 Channel 元数据。兼容行为中省略 channel_type（或传 0）会选择群组类型 2。reset=1 替换订阅者快照。个人 Channel 与 temp_subscriber=1 会被拒绝；临时成员应使用 /tmpchannel/subscriber_set。

x-codeSamples.label: Trusted backend (cURL)
x-codeSamples.source:
# Run only from the trusted backend or operator boundary.
curl --fail-with-body \
  --request POST \
  --url http://127.0.0.1:5001/channel/subscriber_add \
  --header 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{"channel_id":"team-42","channel_type":2,"reset":0,"temp_subscriber":0,"subscribers":["carol"]}'

post.description: Removes the complete durable subscriber set through bounded internal traversal. Person Channels are rejected. This does not delete or disband the Channel.

zh.summary: 移除 Channel 的全部持久订阅者
zh.description: 通过内部有界遍历移除完整持久订阅者集合。个人 Channel 会被拒绝。此操作不会删除或解散 Channel。

x-codeSamples.label: Trusted backend (cURL)
x-codeSamples.source:

curl --fail-with-body \

  --header 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{"channel_id":"team-42","channel_type":2}'

post.description: Replaces the complete member set of the internal temporary Channel (Channel Type 8) identified by channel_id. Temporary membership is separate from ordinary durable subscriber mutation.

zh.summary: 替换临时 Channel 订阅者
zh.description: 替换 channel_id 所标识的内部临时 Channel（Channel Type 8）的完整成员集合。临时 membership 与普通持久订阅者变更相互独立。

  --data '{"channel_id":"ephemeral-42","uids":["alice","bob"]}'

post.description: Adds UIDs to the Channel-scoped denylist. The current compatibility path retains the blacklist name; the domain behavior is a denylist mutation.

post.description: Removes the listed UIDs from the Channel-scoped denylist.

post.description: Canonical endpoint that incrementally scans a UID-owned membership page, hydrates current Channel heads, and returns visible conversations, deletions, and retryable keys. Treat next_cursor as opaque and continue until done=true; an empty page is not proof of completion.

zh.description: Canonical 入口会增量扫描 UID 所属的一页 membership，读取当前 Channel head，并返回可见会话、删除项和待重试键。next_cursor 必须视为不透明值并持续请求到 done=true；空页不代表完成。

x-codeSamples.label: Trusted backend (cURL)
x-codeSamples.source:
# Run only from the trusted backend boundary.
curl --fail-with-body \
  --request POST \
  --url http://127.0.0.1:5001/conversation/list \
  --header 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{"uid":"alice","cursor":"","limit":50,"completed_coverage":0}'

post.description: Re-reads at most 200 unresolved keys without rewinding the completed list coverage. Duplicate keys are coalesced. Person-Channel input uses the peer UID. The response separates rebuilt conversations, deleted keys, and keys that remain unresolved.

zh.description: 重新读取最多 200 个未解析键，不回退已完成的列表 coverage。重复键会合并。个人 Channel 输入使用对端 UID。响应分别返回已重建会话、已删除键和仍未解析键。

x-codeSamples.label: Trusted backend (cURL)
x-codeSamples.source:
# Run only from the trusted backend boundary.
curl --fail-with-body \
  --request POST \
  --url http://127.0.0.1:5001/conversation/retry \
  --header 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{"uid":"alice","channels":[{"channel_id":"team-42","channel_type":2}]}'

post.description: Monotonically advances read_seq to the latest committed Channel head. The request does not accept message_seq; an extra legacy message_seq field is ignored by the runtime and is intentionally absent from this contract.

zh.description: 把 read_seq 单调推进到最新已提交 Channel head。请求不接收 message_seq；运行时会忽略额外的旧 message_seq 字段，因此本合同刻意不发布它。

x-codeSamples.label: Trusted backend (cURL)
x-codeSamples.source:
# Run only from the trusted backend boundary.
curl --fail-with-body \
  --request POST \
  --url http://127.0.0.1:5001/conversations/clearUnread \
  --header 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{"uid":"alice","channel_id":"team-42","channel_type":2}'

post.description: Advances read_seq so at most unread messages remain. It never moves read_seq backwards, so it cannot increase an unread count. This contract requires unread explicitly even though omitted JSON currently decodes as zero.

zh.description: 推进 read_seq，使剩余未读消息至多为 unread。它不会倒退 read_seq，因此不能增加未读数。尽管当前运行时会把缺省 JSON 值解码为 0，本合同仍要求显式提供 unread。

x-codeSamples.label: Trusted backend (cURL)
x-codeSamples.source:
# Run only from the trusted backend boundary.
curl --fail-with-body \
  --request POST \
  --url http://127.0.0.1:5001/conversations/setUnread \
  --header 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{"uid":"alice","channel_id":"team-42","channel_type":2,"unread":3}'

post.summary: Hide a Conversation through the current head
post.description: Persists deleted_to_seq through the latest committed Channel head for this user. It does not delete the Channel or membership; a later committed message can make the Conversation visible again. message_seq is not a request field.

zh.summary: 把会话隐藏到当前 head
zh.description: 为该用户把 deleted_to_seq 持久推进到最新已提交 Channel head。它不会删除 Channel 或 membership；后续已提交消息可使会话再次可见。message_seq 不是请求字段。

x-codeSamples.label: Trusted backend (cURL)
x-codeSamples.source:
# Run only from the trusted backend boundary.
curl --fail-with-body \
  --request POST \
  --url http://127.0.0.1:5001/conversations/delete \
  --header 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{"uid":"alice","channel_id":"team-42","channel_type":2}'

post.description: Records an explicit open, switch, or restore action in activated_at so the Conversation is prioritized in later list synchronization. Send, receive, delivery, and pull paths do not activate it implicitly.

zh.description: 在 activated_at 中记录显式打开、切换或恢复动作，使该会话在后续列表同步中优先。发送、接收、投递和拉取路径不会隐式激活它。

x-codeSamples.label: Trusted backend (cURL)
x-codeSamples.source:
# Run only from the trusted backend boundary.
curl --fail-with-body \
  --request POST \
  --url http://127.0.0.1:5001/conversations/activate \
  --header 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{"uid":"alice","channel_id":"team-42","channel_type":2}'

zh.description: 输入格式错误、校验失败、路由不可用，或 usecase/存储错误

MaintenanceUnavailable.description: Restore maintenance is active; back off and observe /readyz

zh.description: 恢复维护已启用；请退避并观察 /readyz
兼容成功状态，固定为 200。

msg.description: Human-readable runtime message; exact text is not a stable machine contract.

zh.description: 供人阅读的运行时消息；精确文本不是稳定的机器合同。

status.description: Compatibility business-error status, always 400 on these routes.

zh.description: 这些入口的兼容业务错误状态固定为 400。
机器可读的恢复维护类别。
当前维护详情。

BinaryFlag.description: Compatibility integer flag; only 1 means true.

zh.description: 兼容整数标志；只有 1 表示 true。

channel_type.description: Channel Type. Type 1 is a person Channel and cannot include subscribers.

zh.description: Channel Type。类型 1 是个人 Channel，不能包含 subscribers。

reset.description: 1 replaces the durable subscriber snapshot before applying subscribers.

zh.description: 1 表示在应用 subscribers 前替换持久订阅者快照。

subscribers.description: Durable subscriber UIDs. Do not supply them for a person Channel.

zh.description: 持久订阅者 UID；个人 Channel 不得提供。

channel_type.description: Omitted or 0 selects group type 2. Type 1 is rejected.

zh.description: 省略或传 0 会选择群组类型 2；类型 1 会被拒绝。

reset.description: 1 replaces the current durable subscriber snapshot.

zh.description: 1 表示替换当前持久订阅者快照。
必须保持为 0；临时订阅者使用 /tmpchannel/subscriber_set。
非空且元素非空白的持久订阅者 UID。

channel_type.description: Channel Type owning the derived member list.

zh.description: 拥有派生成员列表的 Channel Type。

channel_type.description: Non-person Channel Type required by subscriber_remove_all.

zh.description: subscriber_remove_all 要求的非个人 Channel Type。
完整的临时订阅者快照。

channel_type.description: Channel Type owning the derived allowlist or denylist.

zh.description: 拥有派生 allowlist 或 denylist 的 Channel Type。
要添加或移除的 UID。

channel_type.description: Channel Type owning the derived allowlist.

zh.description: 拥有派生 allowlist 的 Channel Type。

uids.description: Non-blank UIDs to add or remove.

zh.description: 要添加或移除的非空白 UID。

ChannelID.description: Business Channel identifier; the published contract excludes # and @ namespace separators.

zh.description: 业务 Channel 标识；已发布合同排除 # 与 @ namespace 分隔符。
非空业务用户身份。

NonBlankUID.description: Product user identity containing at least one non-whitespace character.

zh.description: 至少包含一个非空白字符的业务用户身份。

cursor.description: Opaque base64url next_cursor returned by the previous page. Do not construct or edit it.

zh.description: 上一页返回的不透明 base64url next_cursor；不要构造或修改。

limit.description: Membership candidates scanned per page. Omitted or 0 selects 50.

zh.description: 每页扫描的 membership 候选数；省略或 0 会选择 50。

completed_coverage.description: Coverage saved from a previous pass only after that pass returned done=true.

zh.description: 仅在上一次完整遍历返回 done=true 后保存并回传的 coverage。

channels.description: Unresolved keys returned by /conversation/list or a previous retry.

zh.description: 由 /conversation/list 或上一次重试返回的未解析键。

channel_id.description: Visible Channel ID. For Channel Type 1, use the peer UID.

zh.description: 可见 Channel ID；Channel Type 1 使用对端 UID。
Channel Type。

channel_id.description: Visible Channel ID. For Channel Type 1, use the peer UID.

zh.description: 可见 Channel ID；Channel Type 1 使用对端 UID。
Channel Type。

unread.description: Maximum unread count to leave after monotonically advancing read_seq.

zh.description: 单调推进 read_seq 后最多保留的未读数。

conversations.description: Visible hydrated Conversations from this membership page.

zh.description: 本 membership 页中已 hydrate 的可见会话。

deletes.description: Keys the client must remove from its local Conversation projection.

zh.description: 客户端必须从本地会话投影中移除的键。

unresolved.description: Keys whose Channel head was temporarily unavailable; retry them with /conversation/retry.

zh.description: Channel head 暂时不可用的键；使用 /conversation/retry 重试。

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. It can be present on an empty page.

zh.description: 下一页的不透明游标；空页也可能携带它。

done.description: True only when this full membership traversal is complete.

zh.description: 仅在本轮完整 membership 遍历完成时为 true。

coverage.description: Nanosecond coverage token for the current pass. Persist it only after done=true.

zh.description: 本轮遍历的纳秒级 coverage token；仅在 done=true 后持久保存。

tombstones_retained_since.description: Oldest deletion coverage still guaranteed; 0 means tombstones have not been expired.

zh.description: 仍有保证的最早删除 coverage；0 表示 tombstone 尚未过期。

reset_required.description: True when completed_coverage predates retained tombstones and the local projection must be rebuilt.

zh.description: 当 completed_coverage 早于保留的 tombstone 时为 true，此时必须重建本地投影。

channel_id.description: Visible Channel ID; a person Conversation uses the peer UID.

zh.description: 可见 Channel ID；个人会话使用对端 UID。
Channel Type。

channel_id.description: Visible Channel ID; a person Conversation is projected to the peer UID.

zh.description: 可见 Channel ID；个人会话会投影为对端 UID。

active_at.description: Nanosecond timestamp of the last explicit activation; 0 means not explicitly activated.

zh.description: 最近一次显式激活的纳秒时间戳；0 表示未显式激活。

read_seq.description: Monotonic badge floor. It is not a message pull cursor or a read receipt.

zh.description: 单调的红点下界；它不是消息拉取游标或已读回执。

deleted_to_seq.description: Messages through this committed sequence are hidden for this user.

zh.description: 截至此已提交 sequence 的消息对该用户隐藏。

unread.description: Unread count after applying join, retention, deletion, own-send, and read floors.

zh.description: 应用加入、保留、删除、自发送与已读下界后的未读数。

last_message.description: Latest visible committed message, or null when no visible message exists.

zh.description: 最新可见的已提交消息；不存在可见消息时为 null。

message_id.description: Numeric server message ID. JavaScript consumers should prefer message_idstr.

zh.description: 数值型服务端消息 ID；JavaScript 消费者应优先使用 message_idstr。
不会丢失精度的服务端消息 ID 十进制字符串。
消息在 Channel 内的已提交 sequence。
Unix 毫秒服务端时间戳。

payload.description: Go JSON representation of payload bytes; nil bytes encode as null.

zh.description: Payload 字节的 Go JSON 表示；nil 字节编码为 null。
